$comment: Every control-plane endpoint this MCP server depends on, and the service-token
scope it expects to authenticate with.
Generated by tests/control-plane-dependencies.test.ts, which runs the handlers
against a recording context rather than reading their source: the paths are
built from template literals, and a regex over the source missed two of them
(/api/agents/{id}/audit and /api/approvals/{id}) until a request failed in
staging. That test fails if this file and the captured calls disagree.
apps/web/tests/mcp-dependency-contract.test.mts reads this file and asserts the
other half: that each path is implemented, requires the scope named here, and
is reachable past both proxy gates. A dependency added here is therefore
checked against the control plane before it can ship.
